recipes.title: Shakshuka
recipes.description: Eggs gently poached in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce. Perfect for a lazy brunch.
recipes.altText: Cast-iron pan of shakshuka with four soft eggs in red tomato sauce, topped with chopped parsley

steps.text: Heat the olive oil in a frying pan over a medium heat. Add the onion and pepper and cook until soft.
Stir in the garlic, cumin and paprika and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in the chopped tomatoes, season and simmer until slightly thickened.
Make four wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each. Cover and cook until the whites are set.
Scatter over the parsley and serve straight from the pan with crusty bread.

recipes.title: Pierogi Ruskie
recipes.description: Polish dumplings filled with potato, twaróg cheese and fried onion. A weekend project worth every fold.
recipes.altText: Plate of golden half-moon dumplings topped with crispy fried onions and a spoonful of sour cream

video.title: Video by Spicewalla on how to fold and seal pierogi

steps.text: Peel the potatoes, cut into chunks and boil in salted water until tender.
Fry the onions in the butter until deep golden. Set half aside for serving.
Mash the potatoes with the twaróg, half the onions and the salt. Leave to cool.
Mix the flour, warm water and oil into a smooth dough. Cover and rest.
Roll the dough thinly, cut out circles, add a spoonful of filling and pinch the edges to seal.
Boil the pierogi in batches until they float, then cook for 2 more minutes.
Serve topped with the reserved onions and sour cream.

recipes.title: Lemon & Herb Roast Chicken
recipes.description: A classic Sunday roast with crispy skin, lemon and thyme.
recipes.altText: Whole golden roast chicken in a roasting tin surrounded by lemon halves and sprigs of thyme

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Take the chicken out of the fridge to come to room temperature.
Mix the butter with the thyme leaves and rub it under and over the skin. Season well.
Halve the lemon and put it inside the chicken with the garlic. Drizzle with olive oil.
Roast until the juices run clear when the thickest part of the thigh is pierced.
Rest the chicken under foil before carving.

recipes.title: Thai Green Curry
recipes.description: Fragrant coconut curry with chicken, green beans and Thai basil.
recipes.altText: Bowl of pale green coconut curry with chicken pieces and green beans, beside a bowl of jasmine rice

steps.text: Fry the curry paste in the oil for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the chicken and stir to coat in the paste. Cook until sealed all over.
Pour in the coconut milk, add the fish sauce and sugar, and simmer.
Add the green beans and cook until just tender.
Stir through the Thai basil and serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
recipes.description: Garlic, chilli and olive oil spaghetti. Dinner in 15 minutes from store-cupboard staples.
recipes.altText: Twirl of glossy spaghetti flecked with sliced garlic, chilli flakes and parsley on a white plate

steps.text: Cook the spaghetti in well-salted boiling water until al dente. Save a mug of the pasta water.
Meanwhile, gently warm the oil with the garlic and chilli until the garlic is pale golden.
Toss the drained spaghetti in the garlic oil with a splash of pasta water until glossy.
Stir in the parsley and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Teriyaki Salmon
recipes.description: Sticky glazed salmon fillets with sesame and spring onion.

steps.text: Mix the soy sauce, mirin, honey and ginger to make the glaze.
Fry the salmon skin-side down in a hot pan until crisp.
Flip the salmon, pour over the glaze and let it bubble until sticky.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and spring onions and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Chocolate Babka
recipes.description: Swirled, buttery enriched bread with a rich chocolate filling.
recipes.altText: Sliced chocolate babka loaf showing dark chocolate swirls through soft golden bread

video.title: Video by Melina Strauss on how to twist and shape a babka

steps.text: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar, eggs and milk into a dough. Knead in the butter until smooth and elastic.
Cover and leave to rise until doubled in size.
Melt the chocolate with the cocoa and icing sugar to make the filling.
Roll the dough into a rectangle, spread with filling, roll up, cut in half lengthways and twist.
Place in a lined loaf tin and prove again.
Bake at 180°C (160°C fan) until deep golden.

recipes.title: Red Lentil Dal
recipes.description: Creamy, comforting lentils with a sizzling spiced oil on top.
recipes.altText: Bowl of creamy yellow lentil dal swirled with spiced oil and topped with fresh coriander

steps.text: Simmer the lentils with the water and turmeric, stirring now and then, until soft and creamy.
Season the dal with salt and keep warm.
Heat the ghee and fry the cumin seeds, garlic and chilli until the garlic turns golden.
Pour the sizzling oil over the dal, scatter with coriander and serve.
